title: Comparing Amlodipine/Atorvastatin Co-Administration To Amlodipine Alone In Patients With Hypertension And Dyslipidemia
brief_summary: To evaluate efficacy of the dual therapy of atorvastatin + amlodipine vs. amlodipine alone .
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects with a diagnosis of both hyperlipidemia and hypertension.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Subjects with Type 1 diabetes mellitus or Type 2 diabetes mellitus.
* Subjects with other atherosclerotic disease.
